scientific_integrity: Proves exact d_pi as the optimal expectation of signed counting-measure full variation by refining continuity partitions and a compactness/minimax argument; proves sharp d_KR equivalence and an exact Poisson intensity-variation formula. The finite checker illustrates algebraic cases but does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-total-intensity processes on Polish spaces only; nonstandard measurable spaces and infinite-intensity local processes are not covered. Equivalent abstract projective transport principles could exist under terminology not used in the inspected point-process literature.
title: Projective transport identity resolves equivalence of point-process distances
